name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: (a) an OCTs-EU forum for dialogue (the ‘OCTs-EU Forum’), which shall meet yearly to bring together OCTs’ authorities, representatives of the Member States, a delegation from the European Parliament and the Commission. Representatives of the EIB and representatives of the outermost regions, local and regional authorities, as well as civil society organisations, indigenous peoples shall, where appropriate, be associated with the OCTs-EU Forum;
